card.name: Word right before a by/for phrase
card.fires_on: Mixed words, often a participle or noun that is about to be followed by a small linking word such as by, for or as. Examples are induced, justified, exchange and free. It also fires partway through long words such as releasing and hyperresponsiveness.

modes.label: Participle before by
modes.description: Past-tense verbs like induced or justified that are followed by 'by'.
modes.example: antibodies<< induced>> by the anthrax vaccine

modes.label: Partway through long words
modes.description: Middle pieces of long technical words such as releasing or hyperresponsiveness.

modes.label: Nouns or adjectives in set phrases
modes.description: Words such as exchange, free or effort that sit in a fixed phrase.
modes.example: Freedom is never<< free>>. By RU Rob
